notes.text: The first man, formed from the dust with God's breath in him (Genesis 2:7) — made, not born, so no parents and no siblings (God calls him alone, Genesis 2:18).

quotes.text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

notes.text: Put in the garden of Eden to dress and keep it (Genesis 2:15); free to eat of every tree but the tree of knowledge — in the day he eats of it he shall surely die (Genesis 2:16-17).
First called Adam here — every earlier verse says only "the man" (Genesis 2:19). He named the animals, but no help meet was found among them (Genesis 2:20).

quotes.text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

notes.text: God built a woman from his rib (Genesis 2:21-22), and Adam named her Woman (Genesis 2:23). Her proper name Eve is not stated until Genesis 3:20 — she joins the tree when Genesis 3 is walked.

quotes.text: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

notes.text: Married: they become one flesh (Genesis 2:24). His spouse stays unknown on the record until Eve enters at Genesis 3:20.
